title: Bulk Regulations
previewText:
Bulk regulations otherwise applicable in C6-6 Districts and equivalent Residential Districts are hereby modified to the extent set forth in this Section and Sections 84-331 through 84-333, inclusive.

The height and setback regulations otherwise applicable in C6-6 Districts, and equivalent Residential Districts, are superseded by the regulations set forth in Section 84-332 (Mandatory front building walls) and 84-333
